claims.claim: The current published release of israeli-bank-scrapers is 6.9.0 (2026-07-22). The npm package declares only a main entry point (lib/index.js) and no bin, so it is library-only with no CLI to invoke.

Upstream israeli-bank-scrapers CompanyTypes enum contains 14 bank scrapers (hapoalim, leumi, mizrahi, discount, mercantile, otsarHahayal, beinleumi, pagi, union, yahav, massad, oneZero, behatsdaa, beyahadBishvilha) and 4 card scrapers (visaCal, max, isracard, amex). Mercantile and Otsar Hahayal are SEPARATE scrapers with their own loginFields, not subsumed under Discount/FIBI.

The Bank of Israel Access to Payment Systems page covers terms of access and connection requirements for the payment systems. It does NOT carry a bank identification-code list: rendered in Playwright on 27 August 2026 with location.href asserted, the page is a landing page last updated 19/11/2023. The two-digit bank codes in references/supported-banks.md, and the previously-stated expansion to three digits by end-2026, are therefore recorded as unverified rather than sourced here.

claims.claim: israeli-bank-scrapers 6.9.0 was released 2026-07-22 and added Leumi savings accounts.
israeli-bank-scrapers 6.9.0 added Max credit card balances.

israeli-bank-scrapers declares engines.node >= 22.22.2, so Node 22 or newer is required. The same registry document was read on 27 August 2026 and still shows 6.9.0 (2026-07-22) as the latest release, so the version pin in this skill did not move this cycle.
israeli-bank-mcp declares israeli-bank-scrapers ^6.7.3, a caret range rather than a hard pin.
il-bank-mcp's packages/scraper declares israeli-bank-scrapers ^6.1.4, a caret range rather than a hard pin.
israeli-bank-mcp is installed by npm install then npm run build, and the MCP client is pointed at node /path/to/israeli-bank-mcp/build/server.js. It declares no bin and is not on npm.
israeli-bank-mcp exposes exactly two tools, fetch-transactions and two-factor-auth, plus the banks://list resource.
israeli-bank-mcp reads credentials from environment variables and never from tool arguments, to keep them out of the LLM conversation history; names are <BANK_ID>_<FIELD>.
claims.raw_snippet: Credentials are read from environment variables (never from tool arguments

claims.claim: israeli-bank-mcp resolves banks through SCRAPERS[bankId] from the library rather than a hardcoded list, so its coverage tracks CompanyTypes even where its README list is stale (it omits Pagi).

The CompanyTypes enum has exactly 18 entries: hapoalim, beinleumi, union, amex, isracard, visaCal, max, otsarHahayal, discount, mercantile, mizrahi, leumi, massad, yahav, behatsdaa, beyahadBishvilha, oneZero, pagi. Enumerated in full and diffed against the skill on 27 August 2026; no row is missing.
il-bank-mcp runs under Docker Compose; the MCP client invokes docker compose run --rm -i mcp-server.
